dashboard.title: Family memory dashboard
dashboard.description: Manage your family tree, media archive, documents, timeline, and future AI modules.

persons.title: People
persons.description: Person catalog with profile, biography, life dates, and genealogy links.

families.title: Families
families.description: Manage family lines, generations, and privacy policies for tree branches.

tree.title: Family tree
tree.description: Pick a surname and root person — the tree rebuilds from them. See everyone with that surname and participants in the selected mode (ancestors / descendants / full).
tree.rendererNote: TreeExplorer uses the API graph contract; TreeCanvas passes nodes/edges to a renderer adapter. React Flow can later be swapped for D3.js or Cytoscape.js without rewriting backend endpoints.

media.title: Media archive
media.description: Photos, video, and voice stories: files in MinIO, metadata in PostgreSQL.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Archive sources, OCR pipeline, review status, and links to persons, families, and events.

search.title: Search
search.description: Local Meilisearch across people, documents, places, and sources. No external search services.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Profile, privacy, themes, future access roles, and self-hosted instance options.
settings.importDesc: GEDCOM import supports preview before writing to PostgreSQL and basic mapping of persons, families, relationships, events, and sources.
